section:
### A further comparison between arms

Standard care is the usual blood pressure treatment given to every patient. Alvenor is a once daily tablet that relaxes the walls of the blood vessels. All data for this comparison were collected at the Oakfield Family Cohort.

Table 4. Counts and means for every group, measure and subset.

| Subset | Arm | Measure | Mean | SD | n |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Younger adults, Reduced kidney function, Community clinic | Standard care | Systolic drop | 9.5 | 4.8 | 750 |
| Younger adults, Reduced kidney function, Community clinic | Alvenor | Systolic drop | 9.8 | 4.9 | 750 |

Each group is reported in the same way for every measure.
